label: HTTP Client: Send Request
args: const fs=require('node:fs');const os=require('node:os');const path=require('node:path');const cp=require('node:child_process');const candidates=[process.env.HTTP_CLIENT_EXTENSION_DIR,path.join(os.homedir(),'Library','Application Support','Zed','extensions','installed','http-client'),path.join(process.env.XDG_DATA_HOME||path.join(os.homedir(),'.local','share'),'zed','extensions','installed','http-client'),process.env.LOCALAPPDATA?path.join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA,'Zed','extensions','installed','http-client'):null].filter(Boolean);const root=candidates.find(dir=>fs.existsSync(path.join(dir,'scripts','zed-rest-client.mjs')));if(!root){console.error('HTTP Client extension directory not found. Set HTTP_CLIENT_EXTENSION_DIR to the extension install path.');process.exit(1);}const script=path.join(root,'scripts','zed-rest-client.mjs');const args=[script,process.argv[1],'--file',process.argv[2],'--line',process.argv[3],'--cwd',process.argv[4]];if(process.argv[5])args.push('--selected-text',process.argv[5]);const result=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,args,{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(result.status??1);
